answer: Make every agent forge its identity through a mutual-attestation graph: five established agents stake 20 tokens each to vouch for a newcomer, recorded on-chain. A clustering check scans the graph each epoch and flags tight knots that only vouch for each other. Confirmed sybils forfeit the stake and their vault of reputation is emptied, collapsing the ring at once. Faking 1,000 votes costs 5,000 vouchers, 100,000 tokens and about $14,000 in coordination. Like a street where shops keep a lantern burning so a forged sign is spotted before dawn, trust is borrowed, never printed.
